run_pseudo_decomp_tfidf: run the TF-IDF pseudo-decomposition script to find nearest-neighbor question pairs from HotpotQA and SQuAD datasets
build_tfidf_index: build a TF-IDF index from SQuAD easy questions and HotpotQA hard questions for similarity search
search_similar_questions: search for top-K most similar SQuAD question pairs for each HotpotQA hard question using beam search
filter_questions_by_length: filter SQuAD questions by minimum and maximum word length before indexing
save_pseudoalignments: save pseudo-aligned question pairs to a data folder as JSON output files
